note: Literature confirms global developmental delay, intellectual disability, and early-onset seizures are hallmark features of RNU2-2 encephalopathy, though epilepsy frequency may be slightly lower (~85%) across broad cohorts.

evidence.text: RNU2-2-associated disease features neurodevelopmental delay and severe intellectual disability, with epilepsy reported in approximately 85% of patients.

evidence.text: Patients with RNU2-2 DEE presented with severe to profound impairment, focal and generalized seizures with a median onset of 24 months, and status epilepticus.

source.title: Pathogenic Variants in RNU2‐2, a Non‐coding Spliceosomal RNA, Cause a Distinctive Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy
